import re
p = 'boltons/dictutils.py'
s = open(p).read()
old = '''    def copy(self):
        "Return a shallow copy of the dictionary."
        return self.__class__(self.iteritems(multi=True))
'''
new = '''    def copy(self):
        "Return a shallow copy of the dictionary."
        return self.__class__(self.iteritems(multi=True))

    def __copy__(self):
        return self.copy()

    def __deepcopy__(self, memo):
        ret = self.__class__()
        memo[id(self)] = ret
        for k, v in self.iteritems(multi=True):
            ret.add(copy.deepcopy(k, memo), copy.deepcopy(v, memo))
        return ret
'''
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new, 1)
open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('done')
EOF
